Here are some elements that each idea should have. Output as a list item for every element.  - One (and only one) protagonist  - A clear dilemma  - A decision  - A climax  - An outcome  - A clever twist  - A clever worldbuilding feature  - The story should involve just a few scenes, ideally a single moment that is pivotal for the character, but doesn't require much exposition. It should immediately jump into action.assistant
